9: *This is a submission for the [Hacktoberfest Open-Source AI Challenge Week 4: Ghost in the Machine](https://dev.to/challenges/hacktoberfest-week4-2026-10-26).*
10: 
11: ## What I Built
12: 
13: A hackathon project can be technically alive and still feel dead.
14: 
15: The repository exists. There may even be a half-working feature. But the next decision is fuzzy, the plan changes every hour, and by demo time nobody can say which result was actually observed and which one was only promised.
16: 
17: I built **Unfinished Business** for that gap.
18: 
19: It is a local-first workshop around OpenCode. Four small spirits take one project from a vague idea to a proposal, a reviewable plan, one bounded implementation, and an evidence-based review. The point is not to make the agent more autonomous. The point is to make the handoffs harder to fake.
20: 
21: OpenCode performs the native work. Entire records the agent sessions and checkpoints behind the project itself. That pairing made provenance part of both the product and the way I built it.
22: 
23: ## Demo

25: - Live interactive example: <https://unfinished-business-demo.onrender.com>
